newsitem.title: USA: Lincoln Nt'l to buy stake in Serfin unit.
newsitem.headline: Lincoln Nt'l to buy stake in Serfin unit.

text.p: Lincoln National Corp said Thursday it agreed to buy a 49-percent stake in Mexico's Grupo Financiero Sefin SA de CV's insurance unit Seguros Serfin.

Lincoln National said it signed a letter of intent to invest $85 million, plus other undisclosed payments that hinge on the company reaching financial targets, in a joint venture with Seguros Serfin. The deal was expected to close by the end of the third quarter.
Grupo Financiero would use the proceeds to strengthen the capital of Banca Serfin, its main banking subsidiary, it said.

Under the deal, the joint venture would sell life and non-life insurance products through Banca Serfin, which has 550 branches in about 230 cities and 250 account officers in Mexico's 15 largest cities. Seguros Serfin writes all lines of insurance business as prescribed under Mexican regulations.

"Lincoln National's interest in Mexico stems from our strategy to expand selectively into international markets with long-term potential," Ian Rolland, Lincoln National's chairman and chief executive. "This joint venture will enable us to leverage our overall insurance expertise as well as our experience in the U.S. bank distribution channels."
The deal would be part of Grupo Financiero Serfin's recapitalization program, which it launched last year and expected to complete later this year.
Lincoln National's investment was subject to regulatory approvals, agreement on the definitive terms and other conditions, the companies said.
